purpose: Teach: 俊輔/ノブ/ひで/裕子/京子/千尋/貞/みゆき

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが甥の俊輔さんを可愛がられた
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he was so fond of our cousin Shinsuke.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic voice. Looking back gently into memory. Slow, measured pace. Slight question at the end — inviting her recollection, not asserting fact.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、ノブ兄さんと将棋を指されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — and your father used to play shogi with my brother Nobu back then, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, engaged, slightly teasing turn at 'didn't he.' Voice full of shared remembering. Affectionate lilt on 'dear' — intimate, long-married.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんはひで兄さんと旧友だった
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he and Hide were old friends.
lines.style: Quieter now. Slight correction in tone — not to contradict, but to gently steer the memory. Deliberate pace. Trailing softly at the period.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、私の妹の裕子と仲良くして下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your father was so kind to my sister Yuko back then, wasn't he, dear? They were always so close.
lines.style: Affectionate, engaged. Playfully insistent — she's building her own case now. Warm tease underneath. 'Dear' carries affection and a light challenge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが京子おばさんと文通された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he corresponded with Aunt Kyoko.
lines.style: Wistful again, more present. A gentle offering. Slight pause before 'corresponded' — the word itself meaningful. Steady, not rushing.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、私の姪の千尋と公園に行かれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Oh, your father took my niece Chihiro to the park so many times when she was little, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Delighted, playful insistence. Light energy — she's enjoying this exchange. Quick-paced, warm throughout. The 'dear' carries knowing affection.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんが「貞淑な方」をご尊敬された
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he greatly admired women of virtue and grace.
lines.style: Reflective, almost philosophical. Slight reverence in the phrasing. Slower pace. The words themselves carry weight — not gossiping, honoring.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、若い頃、私の従妹のみゆきと文通されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And your father exchanged lovely letters with my cousin Miyuki back then, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Knowing smile in the voice. Gentle tease now — playful warmth. She's found her rhythm. Slightly quicker, more confident. 'Dear' is almost conspiratorial.
